answers.workaround: Introducing the `SHADOW_ATTENUATION` built-in has many other applications than just creating custom light shaders: users are able to know if a fragment is in shadow (0.0 is completely shadowed, 1.0 is completely lit, values in-between tell you that the fragment is only partially shadowed), or creating artistically-controlled colored shadows, for example.

title: Decouple shadows from `ATTENUATION` into its own `SHADOW_ATTENUATION` built-in in `spatial` shaders
